Kaplan-Meier quantile calculation

Source: R/km_wlr_calculations_helpers.R
kmq_calculations.Rd

Calculates the quantile time for a Kaplan-Meier curve: the time at which survival drops to qprob (qprob = 0.5 is the median; qprob = 0.25 is the time at which 25\

Usage

kmq_calculations(time_points, survival_probs, qprob = 0.5, type = "midpoint")

Arguments

time_points

Vector of time points (non-decreasing).

survival_probs

Vector of survival probabilities at time_points.

qprob

Survival level (default 0.5): the quantile is the time at which S drops to qprob.

type

Calculation type (midpoint or min).

Value

Estimated quantile time.

Details

With type = "midpoint" the rule of survival::quantile.survfit is used: the first time at which S(t) <= qprob (comparisons within sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)); when S(t) equals qprob on an interval, the midpoint of that interval; when that plateau runs to the last time point, the midpoint between its start and the last time point. NA when the curve never reaches qprob. With type = "min", the first time at which S(t) <= qprob. The curve is taken to start at S = 1 at time 0 and to end at the last element of time_points; values may be NA (they are skipped).
